integrity: Analytical proof with exact rational moment identities and global quadratic derivative sign analysis; accompanying executable verification. Same-model review only, no independent audit or novelty certification. Plausible unindexed equivalent results remain possible.
limitations: Real centered degree-at-most-two symmetric Jacobi polynomials and fourth moments only; no general asymmetric Jacobi, complex, higher-degree, or other-exponent theorem. Part of the alpha=1 upper specialization was known previously.
title: Reentrant fourth-moment minima in symmetric Jacobi two-mode spaces
